# OpenBlog

> A file-based Markdown blog. Write posts as Markdown, brand one config file, and publish a static site.

The guides below are the source of truth. They live in this repository.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/README.md): Map of every guide
- [Start](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/start.md): Clone, install, and run the site
- [Brand](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/brand.md): Name, author, navigation, license, and images
- [Posts](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/posts.md): Post files, series, translations, and drafts
- [Pages](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/pages.md): About and extra Markdown pages
- [Publish](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/publish.md): Build, public URL, feeds, and GitHub Pages
- [Layout](https://github.com/hajiparvaneh/openblog/blob/main/docs/layout.md): Where files and routes live
